quest.title: Simulation: Sweeping the Wilds
quest.description: Alberre is responsible for data collection. Go see what you need to do...

talks.objective: Talk to Alberre, the staff member

dialogues.speaker: Alberre
dialogues.text: My, are you so eager to begin work already?

dialogues.speaker: Alberre
dialogues.text: If you don't mind me saying so, I do think that this plan won't go anywhere. Might as well go over to Lepaute Horlogerie to have some fun, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, is that your honesty coming out to play?

dialogues.speaker: Alberre
dialogues.text: Shh! Pipe down now, pipe down! If someone hears us, they might take me for a hostile spy!

dialogues.speaker: Alberre
dialogues.text: Haha, let's leave this topic at that, shall we? I mean, I just work here, so let's talk work.

dialogues.speaker: Alberre
dialogues.text: Let me state first that this data collection project will be divided into two parts. One will be run by Arbon, and the other by me.

dialogues.speaker: Alberre
dialogues.text: On my side, we wish to model the might of a Champion Duelist, and so we will need you to complete some feats of combat prowess.

dialogues.speaker: Alberre
dialogues.text: We have found some places where monsters often gather and planted data collection devices in the vicinity, so you need only go forth and clear those creatures out.

dialogues.speaker: Alberre
dialogues.text: I have already marked the exact locations on your map. As for any other things of note, they have been written into this manual here, which you can peruse at your leisure.

dialogues.speaker: Alberre
dialogues.text: So, do you have any questions?

dialogues.speaker: Alberre
dialogues.text: Well, in that case, I hope the data gathering session goes like clockwork.
